description: File a "request a higher volume" for HonkIO staff to review. Live keys only: a test key gets 403 LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED. Only available once the account has completed its probation period (get_send_limit → probation.eligible_to_request); one request may be pending at a time (a second returns 409 SEND_LIMIT_REQUEST_PENDING). Omit requested_limit to ask for the standard approved volume (get_send_limit → approved_daily_limit), or name a target above the current cap. The owner is emailed when it is decided. HonkIO is for transactional and relationship messaging: describe what is sent, to whom, and roughly how many a day; bulk marketing is not approved.

reason.description: What is sent and to whom, and the expected daily volume. Staff decide on this.

requested_limit.description: Messages per day wanted (a total, not an increment). Must exceed the current daily limit. Omit for the standard approved volume.

name: request_send_limit
